text: An open mind is like a fortress with its gates unbarred and unguarded.
Hope is the first step on the road to disappointment.
Innocence proves nothing.
Knowledge is power, guard it well.
Blessed is the mind too small for doubt.
Pain is an illusion of the senses, despair an illusion of the mind.
Even in death I still serve.
The difference between heresy and treachery is ignorance.
A small mind is a tidy mind.
To go amongst the stars and meet only death and war — this is the fate of Mankind. To endure it is our glory.
Heresy grows from idleness.
Trust in the Emperor, but keep your bolter ready.
Victory needs no explanation. Defeat allows none.
source: Roboute Guilliman, Primarch of the Ultramarines

text: Suffer not the witch to live.
Only in death does duty end.
We are the Hammer of the Emperor. We are his wrath made manifest.
Faith is the greatest weapon. Doubt is the deadliest sin.
There is no such thing as a plea of innocence in my court. A plea of innocence is guilty of wasting my time.
To admit defeat is to blaspheme against the Emperor.
We have spent ten thousand years learning nothing.
A single man with faith can triumph over a legion of the faithless.
The Emperor protects — but a lasgun helps.
War is not about who is right. It is about who is left.
Blood for the Blood God!
All is dust.
Change is the only constant in the universe.
Grandfather Nurgle's gifts are not given; they are received.
Fear me, for I am your apocalypse.
source: Angron, Primarch of the World Eaters

text: We are already dead. We died the day we put on this armour.
In the grim darkness of the far future, there is only war.
My faith is my armour. My conviction is my weapon.
Loyalty is its own reward.
The first duty of every soldier is to be ready to die.
Hatred is the most pure emotion. It does not lie.
There are no wolves on Fenris.
Doubt is the beginning of wisdom; it is also the beginning of heresy.
A man's worth is measured not in years but in deeds.
The only good alien is a dead alien.
Never yield. The Emperor did not yield, and neither shall we.
Fire is the great cleanser. Let the flames judge the worthy.
Between the hammer and the anvil, a warrior is forged.
Speed is armour. Hesitation is death.
The Chapter is eternal. The warrior is merely its instrument.
We hunt the darkest night so that others may sleep in peace.
Our fury is a gift to the Emperor. Our mercy is a gift we cannot afford.
A fortress is only as strong as the will of its defenders.
The machine spirit endures beyond the flesh.
Rust is not decay — it is the mark of honest toil.
To serve the Emperor is to know true purpose.
The light of the Astronomican is the light of hope made real.
Logic without faith is sterile. Faith without logic is blind.
The greatest weapon of any enemy is the cowardice of one's own allies.
Courage is not the absence of fear. It is fighting despite it.
Every life spent in the Emperor's service is a life well spent.
An army is more than bodies and blades. It is will made manifest.
source: Roboute Guilliman, Primarch of the Ultramarines

text: The enemy does not tire. So neither shall we.
Remember the fallen — and let their sacrifice drive you forward.
Even a man who has nothing can give his life.
The true enemy is never the one in front of you.
It is better to die on your feet than live on your knees.
We march for Macragge!
For Russ and the Allfather!
Sanguinius remembers!
The stars are His eyes. We are His hands.
A candle in the dark is worth more than a thousand suns remembered.
Our greatest weakness is that we believe we can be broken.
Trust is a luxury the Inquisition cannot afford.
We are what stands between Mankind and extinction. Never forget the weight of that.
source: Roboute Guilliman, Primarch of the Ultramarines

text: Chaos is not disorder — it is order that mankind cannot comprehend.
To walk in the light of the Emperor is to never walk alone.
The warp does not forgive. Neither do we.
Ten thousand years of war and still we stand. That is the testament of humanity.
When the darkness comes, hold to the light — even if it burns you.
We are all weapons. The question is in whose hands.
Forge the chains that bind the warp — or it will forge chains for you.
Fear not death. Fear a life without meaning.
source: Death Korps of Krieg regimental motto

text: The Emperor does not ask for your comfort. He asks for your obedience.
We are the shield of the Imperium. We do not advance — we endure.
From the darkness, we strike. Into the darkness, we vanish.
We have always been at war. We will always be at war. This is our inheritance and our glory.
A warrior who ceases to train is a warrior already defeated.
Heresy is like a tree. You must tear it out root and branch.
The stars themselves shall burn before we bow.
There is beauty in destruction, if one has the eyes to see it.
The flesh is weak. Replace it.
We are the sons of the Angel. Nobility is our birthright.
What is a man but the sum of his failures overcome?
source: Lorgar, Primarch of the Word Bearers

text: The night is our dominion. The darkness is our ally.
The greatest victories are won before a single shot is fired.
Burn the land if you must, but deny the enemy his prize.
Do not mourn the dead. Join them or avenge them.
Every world that burns is a world the enemy cannot have.
A prayer is not a shield. But it focuses the soul behind the sword.
The Omnissiah knows all. We merely seek to remember.
Even the darkest night must end.
Die standing, or live forever on your knees. The choice is clear.
The warp is not a place. It is a reflection — and we are what it reflects.
Compassion is the Emperor's province. Vengeance is ours.
A thousand worlds burn so that ten thousand may endure.
We do not know what our end will be. We know only that we will meet it without flinching.
The soul of the warrior is forged not on the battlefield but in the years before it.
I have seen a thousand worlds fall. Each one teaches us something new about how to die well.
Do not ask why we serve. Ask why we would ever stop.
A bolt round is an argument that ends all arguments.
The difference between a hero and a corpse is timing.
Let the galaxy burn. We will rebuild it in the Emperor's image.
The march of time spares no world, no dynasty, no god. Only war endures.
We were old when your stars were young. We will be old when your stars are ash.
The greatest act of mercy is a clean death.
We fight not because we hate what is before us, but because we love what is behind us.
